instruction: Collect the soft bread with golden edges and the square bread with light spots inside the beige breadbasket.

source.instruction: Collect the soft bread with golden edges and the square bread with light spots inside the beige breadbasket.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the breadbasket, which was at x = -0 (right half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the breadbasket, which was at x = -0 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm forward and right toward left bread at (-22, 3, 94) and point downward.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+8, +22, -0) cm, now 32 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, 3, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate left gripper and lower toward left bread at z=82. Move right arm toward right bread at (18, -13, 94).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -12) cm, now 31 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-13, +6, -0) cm, now 19 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, 3, 82) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (18, -13, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Point right gripper down, orient yaw, and lower to z=85.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, -9) cm, now 19 cm (horizontal) / +10 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, 3, 82) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (18, -13, 85) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper further to z=78 around left bread.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -4) cm, now 32 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, 3, 78) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (18, -13, 85) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm to z=78 around right bread and close left gripper.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 32 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket; closed the gripper (opening 0.68: holding the breadbasket); RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -7) cm, now 19 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, 3, 78) opening 0.68; RIGHT fingertips (18, -13, 78) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close right gripper to grasp right bread.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 19 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket; closed the gripper (opening 0.65: holding the breadbasket)

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, 3, 78) opening 0.69; RIGHT fingertips (18, -13, 78) opening 0.65; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift both arms slightly to clear table.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +4) cm, now 32 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +5) cm, now 19 cm (horizontal) / +9 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, 3, 82) opening 0.69; RIGHT fingertips (18, -13, 83) opening 0.66; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift left arm to z=92 and move slightly back toward basket.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, -11, +9) cm, now 25 cm (horizontal) / +17 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket

frames.label: turn 9
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -8, 92) opening 0.68; RIGHT fingertips (17, -13, 83) opening 0.66; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm to basket center at (0, -20, 92).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+22, -11, +0) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +17 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-0, -20, 92) opening 0.69; RIGHT fingertips (17, -13, 83) opening 0.66; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left arm into basket to z=81 and open gripper to release bread.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +7 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket; opened the gripper

frames.label: turn 11

frames.plan: Lift left gripper to z=91 to clear basket.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, +9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (0, -20, 91) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (17, -13, 83) opening 0.66; table z = 74
frames.plan: Retract left arm to home. Lift right arm to z=92 and move over basket at (0, -20).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-30, +0, +4) cm, now 30 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-17, -7, +9) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +17 cm (vertical) from the breadbasket

frames.label: turn 13
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (1, -20, 92) opening 0.66; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm to z=84 and release bread into basket.
